Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Record Class ExplainSummary

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.ExplainSummary
public record ExplainSummary(String stage, String indexName, org.bson.Document indexKey, long documentsExamined, long keysExamined, long documentsReturned, long millis, boolean indexUsed) extends Record
The three numbers that matter in an explain plan, pulled out of the several hundred lines the server actually returns: which index was used (if any), how many documents were examined, and how many were returned.

Raw explain output is technically complete and practically unreadable, so nobody reads it. The ratio of examined to returned is the whole diagnosis: 1:1 means the index did its job, 12,431:3 means a collection scan wearing a disguise.

Pure: it reads an explain document, so the parsing is testable without a server.
